content.description: Trugard acts as a search engine for smart contract risk and intelligence. It has indexed more than 20 million smart contracts and identified nearly 900 thousand malicious contracts, and about 70 thousand wallets that deploy them across multiple networks.
content.meta: Trugard provides blockchain security tools. Discover Trugard and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
